subject: Runway audit & QBR packet — consolidated forecasts + account annotations
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Runway audit & QBR packet — consolidated forecasts + account annotations

Team —

We're one week out from the QBR readout. I pulled the latest runway extract (attached) and we need a consolidated packet for leadership by EOD today. Request:

- Laura: please produce a one-page summary for each top-15 account (account health, committed ARR, expected close date, key risk, next step). Use the "Account one-pager" template in Drive.
- Karthik: reconcile any forecast deltas between field numbers and CRM rollups — flag anything >20% variance.
- Marissa: update the consolidated forecast and call out any deals that need pricing/discount exceptions for Finance.

Attachments: runway-raw-extract.csv (CSV) — raw pull from pipeline.

Target timeline: consolidated PDF + per-account one-pagers into the shared folder by 5pm PT. If you hit blockers, call me.

Diego
Diego Fernandez
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 10:30:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway audit & QBR packet — consolidated forecasts + account annotations

Diego —

Uploading first pass: I created qbr-accounts-onepager.pdf (attached) with condensed notes for the top 15 by ARR. Highlights:

- Helios Retail (Sarah): Cloud migration delay — expected close moved from May -> July; risk: integration lead time.
- NuvemTech (Mike): Procurement signed off on security questionnaire; typical 30-day procurement window expected.
- ACME Corp: Procurement has a pricing question — may require a purchase order amendment.

A few format notes: I included an "ask" line at the top of each one-pager (e.g., "Need discount approval" or "Confirm deployment window"). I also linked to the HubSpot record in each page.

Attachment: qbr-accounts-onepager.pdf (6 pages). Putting the editable one-pagers in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR_PACKET_FOLDER

If anyone has updated numbers, drop them in the shared sheet and I'll regenerate the PDF.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference

To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, diego_fernandez@redwood.ai

> Uploading first pass: I created qbr-accounts-onepager.pdf (attached) with condensed notes for the top 15 by ARR.

Quick reconciliation note: Helios Retail CRM shows $1.2M in late-stage ARR (best case) but field forecast reflects $900k due to the integration dependency Sarah mentioned. I dug into the opportunity timeline and flagged the following:

- Opportunity 4521: closing probability should be 45% not 70% (previously overstated).
- Opportunity 4527: procurement is close, legal is the blocker — I'll ping legal and include the expected cycle time.

Action: I updated helios-forecast-adjustment.xlsx in Drive with the adjusted figures. Laura, can you swap in that file before creating the final PDF?

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Field Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Runway audit & QBR packet — consolidated forecasts + account annotations

Diego / team —

Attached updated forecast numbers and a short exceptions list. Key callouts:

- Helios Retail: rolling the $300k from May into Q3 per Sarah's note. Marked as "timing risk".
- NuvemTech: moved $450k from "commit" to "committed - pending PO", procurement submitted PO yesterday per Mike Lawson.
- ACME Corp: request for 10% net-new account discount — requires Finance review.

HubSpot records used to compile numbers: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/7890
DocuSign for ACME SOW: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/DS-2027-089

Attachments: helios-forecast-adjustment.xlsx (XLSX), consolidated-forecast-v2.csv (CSV stub).

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway audit & QBR packet — consolidated forecasts + account annotations

Thanks team — excellent triage. Final notes / leadership direction before we lock the packet: 

1) Helios Retail: Laura, in the one-pager please add the mitigation plan (two-week integration pilot) and owner (Karthik). We need a one-sentence impact line for the exec deck.
2) ACME discount: Marissa, please open a quick Finance review with Eduardo and request an answer by EOD tomorrow. If Finance asks for a compensation clause, loop Legal.
3) NuvemTech: Diego, confirm if we should treat as "committed - operational" for the QBR runway numbers or the conservative bucket. My recommendation: treat as committed if PO is in hand; otherwise conservative.

Final deliverable: single-page executive summary + appendix with the 15 account one-pagers by 6pm PT. Laura, Marissa — I will sign off on the packet once the items above are reflected.

Tessa
Tessa Morgan
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
